title: Bacteriology Laboratory
objective: Complete bacteriology workflow from sample reception to archiving
content: Bacteriology Laboratory notebook template with workflow pages for clinical, environmental, food/beverage, and veterinary sample processing.

pages.title: Sample Reception
pages.instructions: Import sample manifest and verify sample receipt. Check that all samples match the manifest. Inspect for damage, proper labeling, and temperature compliance. Capture all reception metadata including project information, participant details, collection data, storage conditions, and consent status.
pages.content: Sample Reception - Manifest Import and Verification

pages.title: Laboratory Reception & Verification
pages.instructions: Confirm physical receipt and validate sample quality. Use the QC checklist to assess temperature compliance, volume, labeling, packaging integrity, contamination, leakage, and container type. Passed samples proceed to Temporary Storage Assignment. Failed samples can be discarded or kept with flagged status.
pages.content: Laboratory Reception and Verification - Quality Control Assessment

pages.title: Isolate Creation
pages.instructions: Create bacterial isolates from verified samples. Select parent samples and specify isolate type and number of isolates. Child isolates maintain parent-child hierarchy for traceability. Mark samples as processing complete when ready for storage assignment.
pages.content: Isolate Creation - Create child isolates from parent samples

pages.title: Sample Storage Assignment
pages.instructions: Assign samples to storage locations after QC. Select storage type (Temporary for awaiting processing, Long-Term for processed samples/isolates). Use hierarchy: Room -> Device/Freezer -> Shelf -> Rack -> Box -> Well. Record exact placement for retrieval.
pages.content: Sample Storage Assignment - Storage and Environmental Monitoring

pages.title: Processing & Quality Control
pages.instructions: Prepare culture and biochemical media with IQC verification. Test antibiotic discs with ATCC control strains. Process samples through Gram staining, microscopy examination, inoculation onto appropriate media, and incubation. Record QC results and document any failures with retake options.
pages.content: Processing & Quality Control - Media preparation, inoculation, and QC verification

pages.title: Assay/Test Execution
pages.instructions: Execute comprehensive bacteriology tests including microscopy examination, culture isolation, biochemical identification, drug susceptibility testing (disc diffusion, MIC, E-test), automated identification (VITEK, Phoenix, MALDI-TOF), and molecular techniques (PCR, WGS). Record all results with QC validation.
pages.content: Assay/Test Execution - Comprehensive bacteriology testing and result recording

pages.title: Post-Analysis Storage
pages.instructions: Select samples to assign to post-analysis storage. Choose aliquot type (isolate, DNA, primary sample), storage media (STGG, glycerol stock, bead system), container type, and storage conditions. Record environmental temperature logs twice daily.
pages.content: Post-Analysis Storage - Store processed samples with appropriate conditions and environmental monitoring

pages.title: Sample Retrieval, Archival & Disposal
pages.instructions: Manage sample lifecycle closure. Retrieve samples for shipping, retesting, or research with approval workflow. Transfer isolates and DNA to biorepository for long-term archival. Dispose samples using appropriate methods (autoclave, incineration, chemical treatment) with full documentation and supervisor sign-off.
pages.content: Sample Retrieval, Archival & Disposal - Final stage of sample lifecycle

pages.title: Reporting & Data Export
pages.instructions: Finalize bacteriology results and export data. Generate culture result reports, antibiotic susceptibility testing (AST) reports, and QC summaries. Export data in WHONET format for AMR surveillance. Submit to REDCap or other external systems. Archive completed samples with full chain of custody documentation.
pages.content: Reporting & Data Export - Report generation and data export for AMR surveillance
